primary: Single native-tail temporal-coverage characterization plus all320 external-arrival service outcomes. No victim-policy comparison or SLO goodput claim.
slo: No application SLO. Inherited20point frontier is diagnostic only.
hypothesis: Previous pressure occurs after arrivals finish. A fixed initial burst plus late stream may expose heterogeneous legal victim states during arrivals, or native admission may absorb the phase difference.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic temporal diagnostic on already-seen inputs, not independent confirmation or representative production traffic. New legal opportunities are not actual alternative actions or causal service gains.
retention: One fixed tail cell only, no automated retry, no moving the stream start or changing its cadence after absent overlap/opportunity. Preserve all prior inputs, failures and negative results.
simple_comparators: Tail only for opportunity characterization; no policy improvement inferred across changed arrival workloads.
